chunks: Aban narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about circumambulation behind the Maqām. He said: “I do not like that, though I do not consider there to be any harm in it. So do not do it unless you find no alternative to it.”

key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: the Station, referring here to Maqam Ibrahim
key_terms.مَا أُحِبُّ: I do not prefer or approve of it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform tawaf behind Maqam Ibrahim if there is no other option?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on performing tawaf behind Maqam Ibrahim. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that although he does not prefer it, he does not regard it as invalid or sinful, and permits it in cases of necessity.
